reading: The UK government and the EU plan to publish two agreements on Thursday.
They agreed on these plans last week.
The new deal will reduce checks on food moving between the UK and the EU.
UK businesses selling food to the EU will also have less paperwork, such as forms to complete.
The government hopes these changes will help customers pay less for food.
But customers may not see lower prices in shops.
The BBC says the agreements include a special rule for the first ten years.
Under this rule, the side ending the deal would pay to rebuild border infrastructure.
This means buildings and other things needed for border checks.

vocabulary.definition: To make information available for people to read.
Plans or rules that two sides accept.
Careful looks at things to see if they follow the rules.
Forms and other papers that people need to complete for work.
People who buy things from a shop or business.
